ns2:course.label: Roman Republic to 44 B C
ns2:course.description: Examination of the political, social, economic, military, institutional, religious and cultural development of Rome from 753 BCE until 14 CE. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history or consent of instructor.
